dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Notice
dialogues.text: "Gold is noble, and silver bright — but which metal would truly please the <color=#00E1FFFF>Iron-Faced Gatekeeper's</color> sight?\nAs the saying goes, <color=#00E1FFFF>like calls to like</color>, so perhaps the answer is already cut and dried."

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Notice
dialogues.text: (A line of tiny text is written in the corner of the notice, easy to miss if one isn't paying attention.)\n"And if all else fails, <color=#00E1FFFF>winning by brute force</color> still makes you the hero."
